About Nana

From Hustle
to Systems.

Africa has the talent. Many of our businesses still run on the founder alone. That is the problem I work on.

My name is Enoch Kofi Boateng. Most people call me Nana. In 2022 I founded Sash Afrique Ltd, a handwoven Kente sash brand that celebrates achievers. Building it taught me most of what I now teach. I hold an MBA in Impact Entrepreneurship and Innovation from UPSA, and I use both to help other founders grow.

I started designing to survive university. That work grew into a company. Today I write, speak and advise on what it takes to build a business that lasts in Ghana.

Entrepreneurship as Transformation
Good businesses create jobs and solve real problems.
Customers Decide Value
We listen to the people who pay us and build around what they need.
Systems Over Hustle
Growth comes from the right systems. Working longer hours only takes you so far.
Creating Lasting Opportunity
Build enterprises that pay people well and keep wealth in our communities.
What I Do

How I Create Value

I share what I have learned building Sash Afrique. You can work with me in three ways.

01

Entrepreneur & Founder

I run Sash Afrique Ltd, a handwoven Kente sash company serving graduates, schools, churches and organisations in Ghana. Every lesson I teach comes from running it.

02

Growth Leader & Strategist

I work with founders and SMEs on pricing, customer experience, lead generation and operations. We look at where the money leaks and fix the systems behind it.

03

Speaker & Writer

I speak to students, founders and teams on entrepreneurship, growth and leadership. I also write here and teach small business finance on TikTok and YouTube.

New Book

The Benefits of Divine Defects

Why Your Weaknesses Are Part of the Plan

You weren't built to be good at everything. This book makes the case that's actually the point. Drawing on scripture, stories, and his own experience building Sash Afrique, Nana Boateng argues that your weaknesses aren't flaws to hide. They're the reason you need other people, and the reason other people need you. Stop performing. Start being honest about what you can't do, and build with the people who can.

Ten chapters that move from Genesis to Paul's letters to stories from Ghana and beyond, all making one case: your gaps are part of the design.
Written for founders, leaders, and anyone tired of pretending they have it together.
Stories and reflection questions in every chapter. No borrowed frameworks, no polished formulas.
You will walk away knowing which limitation to stop fighting, and who to build with instead.

Flagship Venture · Since 2022
Sash Afrique Ltd
Handwoven Kente sashes for achievers
Flagship Venture · Accra, Ghana

The Sash Afrique Story

Where it started. Graduates and institutions in Ghana were marking big moments with plain sashes that said nothing about who they are. In January 2022, Nana Boateng registered Sash Afrique Ltd to change that.

Our weavers make each sash by hand. The achiever chooses the words on it. It says I made it, and I am proud of where I come from.

From one customer. Sash Afrique's first client was Yaw Serlom. That single order proved the idea. Within two years, the business had celebrated over 10,000 achievers and produced 4,000+ personalised recognition moments, serving universities, professional associations, churches, and corporate organisations across Ghana.

We have produced sashes and medals for the Ghana Education Service, served the Youth Model Parliament with bulk orders for two years, and made the class sash for the UPSA MBA Class of 2026.

What comes next. We want every achiever in Africa to have a sash that tells their story. We grow one order and one partner at a time.

Youth Initiative
EmpowerNext
Initiative · Pan-African

EmpowerNext

EmpowerNext is my youth entrepreneurship initiative. Many young Ghanaians want to start a business. Few get practical guidance on how to do it. EmpowerNext gives them tools, frameworks and mentorship they can use straight away.

What EmpowerNext delivers:

Workshops on the basics: from idea to first customer, pricing and simple systems. Mentorship circles that connect young founders with people who have built businesses. Lessons drawn from building Sash Afrique.

Interested in bringing EmpowerNext to your institution or community? Get in touch.

Long-Term Vision
Naboat Groupe
Holding Vision · Pan-African

Naboat Groupe

Naboat Groupe is the long term plan behind my ventures. It is not a registered company yet. It is how I decide what to build next and how each venture supports the others.

Sash Afrique celebrates achievement. EmpowerNext prepares the next generation of achievers. Advisory work strengthens other businesses and funds new ones.

The pillars of Naboat Groupe:

Recognition and culture: Sash Afrique. Education: EmpowerNext and mentorship. Strategy and advisory: work with founders and SMEs.
